axis_notes.en: Categories are practical asset forms, not a scientific phylogeny. Unknown arrays are unassigned, not all-time/all-environment compatibility. Packs do not create duplicate records. Broad intervals do not assert exact regional coexistence.
axis_notes.zh: 分类是实用资源形态，不是科学系统树。空数组表示未指定，并非适用于全部时代或环境。多包归属不增加资源计数；宽泛时期不代表精确地域共存。
